description: The Commit card calls this tool to read where the dealership hand-off stands after the buyer confirms a choice. The assistant does not call it. It answers one `state`: `held` (the hand-off is waiting and has not gone yet), `sending` (it is on its way), `sent` (the dealership has been told), `checking` (Ridekick is checking whether it went), `needs_us` (it has not gone through yet, and a person at Ridekick is on it), `unreadable` (Ridekick cannot read it right now and is checking), `practice` (this is a practice request, so nothing was sent to any dealership), or `none` (no choice has been confirmed). For `checking` and `unreadable`, it is not known whether the dealership has been told.
name: commit_handoff
title: Check the dealership got it
